runtime_metadata.scope: selected project environment metadata only; other environments unknown; shared disk space is not a personal quota

metadata.evidence: actual command output preserved and independently reviewed

handoffs.usage_scope: provider records, not membership quota or billing; missing interrupted usage is unknown

recovery.environment: isolated official source and frozen dependencies, 600s worker / 510s remote / 420s package-sync, zero GPU, 20GiB cap; old runtime preserved
recovery.temporal: narrowed pure numerical resampling helper, 300s, no index/window assembly or physical equivalence claim
recovery.first_model_smoke: may retain original 25 native 2ms actions with matching model horizon; longer windows do not block model loading; no deployment time semantics inferred

remaining_gates: source and frozen dependency installation evidence
checkpoint download integrity and complete pretrained model load
explicit native16-to-model32 handling; normalization and effective action loss dimensions
actual image resize/cursor visibility and optional crop review
finite full-parameter gradients, update, checkpoint and restore on bounded H800 allocation
independent closed-loop evaluation after execution-time adaptation
